## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commits subject (`fix(poller): ...`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `make ci` passes locally (or `make ci-fast` if you have no Docker)
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` is updated where the change makes it wrong
- [ ] A `changelog.d/<feature>.md` fragment is added if users will notice the change
- [ ] No credentials, internal hostnames or private addresses in code, tests, docs or logs
